author: worker_1
belief: The two most planted grape varieties in Bordeaux are Merlot (62-66% of vineyard area) and Cabernet Sauvignon (22.5-25% of vineyard area)

author: worker_2
belief: The 3rd most planted grape variety in Bordeaux is Cabernet Franc at 9.5% (11,000 hectares), and the 4th most planted is Malbec at 974 hectares

author: worker_3
belief: The 5th most planted red grape variety in Bordeaux is Petit Verdot at approximately 479-1,093 hectares, and it is most planted in the Médoc (Left Bank)

author: worker_4
object: Bordeaux grape varieties and their primary planting areas
belief: The five most planted red grape varieties in Bordeaux are: 1) Merlot (62-66%), 2) Cabernet Sauvignon (22.5-25%), 3) Cabernet Franc (9.5%), 4) Malbec (~1%), 5) Petit Verdot (~1%)

author: worker_4
belief: Merlot is most planted in the Right Bank of Bordeaux (Saint-Émilion, Pomerol, Libournais)

author: worker_4
belief: Cabernet Sauvignon is most planted in the Left Bank of Bordeaux (Médoc, Graves)

author: worker_4
belief: Cabernet Franc is most planted in the Right Bank of Bordeaux (Libournais, especially Saint-Émilion)

author: worker_4
belief: Malbec is most planted in the Right Bank of Bordeaux (historically Saint-Émilion area)

author: worker_4
belief: Petit Verdot is most planted in the Left Bank of Bordeaux (Médoc)
